content.text:
Based on Airbnb's (ABNB) most recent SEC filings I'm aware of, the share counts were approximately:

Class A: ~ 600 million shares

Class B: ~ 0 shares (Class B common stock converted to Class A in connection with the company's transition, with minimal or no shares remaining)

Note: Airbnb's share counts change over time due to stock-based compensation, share repurchases, and conversions. My figures may be outdated, so for the exact current number, please check the cover page of Airbnb's latest 10-K or 10-Q filing on the SEC's EDGAR database or Airbnb's investor relations site.
